# GCP to AWS Migration Guide

This guide covers migrating your AI workloads from Google Cloud Platform to Amazon Web Services.

## Model Selection

For your generative AI workloads, we recommend using Claude 4 Turbo on Amazon Bedrock.
This model provides excellent performance for migration-related tasks and code generation.

## Migration Steps

2. Configure model invocation
3. Test your AI workloads
